comparison.objective: Read a printed six-note phrase and play it in time with two mallets; not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rhythmic tool striking, inter-arm scheduling, and rebound control versus fine rotary manipulation and iterative adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Six correct alternating notes at half-second intervals; wrong or late strikes are irreversible. Explicit timing tolerance and strike-force bounds are missing.
comparison.reason: Timed impact performance is meaningfully different from observing impacts to calibrate a device.
